title: TSK implementation and coupled radius-ridge selection clarifications

scaling.fit_scope: raw observations available through the final fitting target only; chronological-validation targets and all test observations excluded
scaling.freeze_policy: the fitting-segment scaler remains frozen for validation, antecedent optimization, complete-pretest consequent refit, and test forecasting; it is not refit after antecedent optimization

subtractive_clustering_initialization.data: joint column matrix [X_fit, y_fit] in the frozen scaled domain
subtractive_clustering_initialization.algorithm: deterministic Chiu-style subtractive clustering inherited from V1
subtractive_clustering_initialization.antecedent_centers: retain only the X dimensions of accepted joint centers
subtractive_clustering_initialization.particle0: concatenate centers and positive widths, then clip to the already frozen antecedent bounds

ridge_solve.regularized_parameters: all first-order TSK consequent coefficients including intercepts
ridge_solve.system: solve (Phi.T Phi + alpha I) beta = Phi.T y
ridge_solve.alpha_default: none; alpha must be supplied explicitly from the frozen selection procedure

coupled_radius_ridge_selection.candidate_pairs: Cartesian product of frozen radius grid and frozen alpha grid
coupled_radius_ridge_selection.condition_value: median MASE across paired optimizer replicates within each development forecasting condition
coupled_radius_ridge_selection.selection_statistic: median of condition values across development conditions

firing_numerics.normalized_weights: stable log-sum-exp softmax of raw log firing strengths
firing_numerics.coverage_penalty: compute from log total firing with numerical floor log(1e-300), algebraically equivalent to the frozen definition
firing_numerics.jacobian: analytic derivative must be consistent with the same normalized-weight definition and validated against finite differences

scientific_effect: clarifies previously underspecified implementation details before development; does not use development or final performance outcomes
